title: Item 15c · “Both” in the top bar
subtitle: Approved in each section. With “Both” chosen, sections show both schools in one of two ways: everything, one school under the other (Prospects and Schedule; Camps with a School column; Calendar with W/S letters), or one summary box per school with “Open [school]” (Finance, v0.198 — each school closes its own drawer). Star's and Black Belt's events are for both schools anyway. Color Belt shows nothing and asks you to choose a school — your own rule (v0.34/v0.35: each school's testing kept separate so staff can't change the other school's event by mistake; “may be revisited”). The words differ too: “Both schools” (Prospects, Calendar, Forms, Camps' School column) vs “Worcester and Shrewsbury” (Home, Schedule, Camps' page line). (Preview screenshots at PC size · fake data)

columns.label: Proposed · Color Belt on “Both”, two ways

items.caption: 5. Option B (recommended) — Finance's boxes: “Both schools” under the title, one box per school with its upcoming testing, and Open Worcester / Open Shrewsbury. Nothing can be changed on Both, so your separation rule stays.
6. Option C — Schedule's list: every event, one school under the other, under Schedule's school headings; Add event would first ask “Which school?”, as Schedule does.

columns.note: Both copy what's already there — picture 5 is Finance's Both page, picture 6 is Schedule's. In B and C every page says “Both schools”, the word on the “Both” button (Home's date line and Schedule's and Camps' page lines change). Pictures 5–6 are drawn over the real Color Belt page; nothing in the app was changed.

footer:
Your choice — one question: what should Color Belt show on “Both”?
A · Keep as today. + no work; your separation rule stays. − Color Belt is the one section that shows nothing on “Both”; the two wordings stay.
B · Recommended: Finance's boxes (picture 5). One box per school with its upcoming testing events and “Open Worcester” / “Open Shrewsbury” (today's two school buttons, moved into the boxes). Nothing can be changed until a school is opened. + the owner sees both schools' testing at a glance; your separation rule stays; the same Both page you chose for Finance, so the two sections that hold each school's money work alike. − one small new view in Color Belt.
C · Schedule's list (picture 6). All three Color Belt tabs show both schools, one under the other; Add event asks “Which school?”. + works like Prospects, Schedule and Camps. − reverses your v0.34/v0.35 separation rule; the biggest job in this item (three tabs need a Both view).
B and C also make the words the same everywhere: “Both schools”.
